description: List live deals currently published on StackTheDeal (stackthedeal.com). Deals are verified on the retailer's own page before posting. Returns the newest deals first, with price, regular price, discount percentage, store, and a link to each deal's page on stackthedeal.com (results link to our pages only — the retailer's link lives on that page). An optional sort orders the results instead: 'price_asc' cheapest first, 'price_desc' priciest first, 'discount_desc' biggest percent off first. With category 'travel', the result also carries travel_partners: the travel booking partners StackTheDeal is connected to (flights, hotels & tours, car rental, airport transfers, travel eSIM), each linked to its section of stackthedeal.com/travel/.

category.description: Category filter, e.g. amazon, electronics, home, baby-kids, travel, bonus.

hot_only.description: Only deals StackTheDeal flagged as hot.

min_discount_pct.description: Only deals at least this percent off (0-100).

offset.description: Pagination: skip this many matches (use the next_offset from the previous result to page further).

sort.description: Sort order: "relevance" (default — best match / catalog order), "price_asc" (cheapest first — use when the user asks for the cheapest), "price_desc" (priciest first), "discount_desc" (biggest percent off first).

store.description: Store filter, exact name, e.g. Amazon, Walmart, Costco.

name: list_deals
title: List live deals
